questions.solution:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

Cyclicity chart:

NumberCyclicityUnit digit values

(Note: when remainder is 0, power = cyclicity)

In (22 x 33)17 = 72617

Unit digit of 726 is 6.

From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 6 is 1.

So, we have to divide the power of 726 i.e.17 by 1.

After dividing 17 by 1, remainder = 0. So, power = cyclicity = 1

Unit digit of 61 = 6

In (14 x 18)22 = 25222

Unit digit of 252 is 2.

From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 2 is 4.

So, we have to divide the power of 252 i.e. 22 by 4.

After dividing 22 by 4, remainder = 2. So, power ≠ cyclicity

In this case, unit digit of 22 = 4

Therefore, sum unit digit of ((22 x 33)17 + (14 x 18)22) = 6 + 4 = 10

1 - cos6 2A - sin6 2A

= 1 - [(cos2 2A)3 + (sin2 2A)3]

questions.question: How many terms are there in the series 1/0.01 + 1/0.001 + 1/0.0001 +⋯ = 11111100 ? श्रृंखला 1/0.01 + 1/0.001 + 1/0.0001 +⋯ = 11111100 में कितने पद हैं?
questions.solution:
Given series is in the form of G.P.:

Then, first term = a = (1/0.01)

Common ratio = r = (1/0.001)/(1/0.01) = 10

Let total terms = n

Sum = a(rn - 1)/(r - 1) = 11111100

(1/0.01)(10n - 1)/(10 - 1) = 11111100

10n = 106

n = 6 terms
